patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Clay only if your buying job matches “GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free ” rather than Cognism's shape. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Clay's shape. Workflow advantage: Clay leans lead-management; Cognism leans contact-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Clay and Cognism share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Clay is GTM data enrichment and workflow platform for multi-provider waterfall prospecting — Free + Launch from ~$167/mo headline, Growth, Enterpris; Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale.
- Company-size focus: Clay (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Cognism (mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Clay-leaning lead-management vs Cognism-leaning contact-management.
- Researched limits: Clay — Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach.

Limitations — Clay: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model; Credit consumption across providers requires ongoing cost governance; Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing.

Poor-fit cases: Clay is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Learning curve is steep for non-technical GTM users — table/waterfall mental model · Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Avoid Clay if you actually need Cognism's motion (Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobile)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
